mixture_of_experts.summary: Several small networks each learn a different kind of market, and a gate decides how much to trust each one for this bar.
mixture_of_experts.implementationNote: Dense soft routing: every expert scores every bar and the gate's softmax weights mix their hidden outputs before one shared linear head, so there is no top-k sparsity and no load-balancing loss; the gate probabilities per bar are shown in Inside the model.

expert_count.label: Expert count
expert_count.description: How many expert networks the gate chooses between.

expert_hidden_size.label: Expert hidden size
expert_hidden_size.description: How many units each hidden layer of an expert has.

expert_layer_count.label: Expert layer count
expert_layer_count.description: How many hidden layers each expert stacks.

gate_hidden_size.label: Gate hidden size
gate_hidden_size.description: How many units the gating network's hidden layer has before it scores the experts.

dropout.label: Dropout
dropout.description: The share of expert units switched off at random during training, so no expert can lean on any one of them.

learning_rate.label: Learning rate
learning_rate.description: How big a step each weight update takes.

weight_decay.label: Weight decay
weight_decay.description: A pull of every weight toward zero, which keeps the experts and the gate simple.

batch_size.label: Batch size
batch_size.description: How many bars one weight update averages over.

epochs.label: Epochs
epochs.description: How many passes over the training bars at most.

patience.label: Patience (epochs)
patience.description: Stop after this many epochs without a better validation loss; the best epoch is kept.
